issue_records.title: MethodError when indexing DenseAxisArray with wrong number of dimensions
issue_records.body_excerpt:
```julia
  using JuMP

  model = Model()
  keys = [(:a, :b)]

  @variable(model, x[keys])

  x[(:a, :b)]  # correct
  x[:a, :b]    # ERROR: no method matching one(::Symbol)
```

The method error principle says we need a more useful error message.
